subtasks.description: Evolve meeting records into a compatible Conversation model and call-oriented navigation without losing existing IDs.
Build the primary report around summary, outcome, QA/evidence and review action; progressively disclose advanced panels.
Add audio/transcript synchronized navigation, speaker/time filters and explicit incomplete-analysis notices.
Generate supported summary/decision/key-moment fields with evidence, abstaining on unspecified details.
Implement transcript text and turn-to-speaker correction as new immutable revisions, with reason and reviewer identity.
Mark dependent scores/summaries/search projections stale and selectively recompute against the corrected revision.
Test Persian/English report usability and keyboard playback/evidence navigation with representative supervisors.
